datasheet_identity.title: SSL54B THRU SSL510B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Multi-part datasheet SSL54B-SSL510B; SSL54B column: VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V (p. 1 maximum ratings). IF(AV) = 5.0 A and IFSM = 150 A (8.3 ms half sine) are common to all types.
High-temperature reverse current IR2 = 50 mA maximum at VR = VDC, Ta = 100 degC (p. 2, common cell) transcribed for reference only; the 25 degC row is the leakage input.

Curve digitization method: page 2 rasterized at 600 dpi; Fig.3 axes calibrated from printed gridlines (x: 0-2.0 V linear at 0.25 V per gridline; y: 0.1-100 A log). The solid SSL54B/SSL545B curve is the leftmost of three; positions measured at fixed currents by pixel run tracing with gridline columns excluded. Digitized 0.378 V at 5.0 A is consistent with the 0.45 V maximum table limit at the same current.

Fig.1 (derating) and Fig.2 (surge) are thermal/surge ratings and were not digitized. Fig.4 (typical reverse characteristics) plots reverse current against percent of rated peak reverse voltage and was not digitized because its abscissa is normalized, not an absolute voltage.
No reverse recovery time is published anywhere in the datasheet (Schottky rectifier).
No avalanche/breakdown voltage row is published; VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
